d:
"When I first saw people rollerblading, I felt like they were flying on the ground … I wanted that feeling to move without limits and see my city in a new way."
Most people don’t picture Cairo like this. But for Mostafa and his friends, rollerblading is how they experience it: weaving through Zamalek, racing along the Nile, even gliding near the pyramids.
And they’re not alone. More and more riders are claiming Cairo’s streets — moving freely, connecting deeply, and being unapologetically themselves in a city that never slows down.
